01-main.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One FULL-SCREEN 16:9 widescreen desktop screenshot, one screen state, for the same original Chinese-language plush woolball FPS 绒仔 / RONGBOY. Images are art and layout references, preserve the actual needle-felt soft props and handcrafted short fibers, cinematic miniature set lighting, no hardware or browser frame. Use a consistent simple console UI: cream Chinese lettering with clear readable letterforms, forest-green shadow backplate when text needs contrast, one honey/ochre highlight for current selection, large display and ample safe margins. For exact UI labels use only the explicitly listed short Chinese strings and controller/keyboard key names, typographically accurate, no gibberish or extra slogans. Very polished, clean at MacBook size, no website navbar, mobile widgets, glassmorphism, placeholder text, editorial slide headings, collage or arrows between screens. Every control should look possible to put real focus on. Traditional keyboard/controller footer, where indicated labels for Enter / ✕ confirm and Esc / ○ back.
ART AND CAMERA: replicate the identity, late-afternoon courtyard, open stitched gate, khaki sleeves and spool gun on the RIGHT of reference concept A with substantially the same framing. The garden and one small green X-button zombie behind the hedge remain. Replace its menu completely with a TRADITIONAL vertical GAME MAIN MENU. Upper left same iconic brush-felt title “绒仔” then small “RONGBOY”. Exactly FOUR large selectable labels in this order in dark, quiet lower left negative space: “选关”, “设置”, “练习”, “图鉴”. “选关” is focused, one ochre stitched focus highlight. No map names, no enter-garden button, no other visible navigation, no HUD. At the bottom small “↑ ↓ 选择　Enter / ✕ 确认”. Keep actual first-person perspective and original close composition. The viewer is waiting at the gate, not yet playing.
